flow_ref: ACM_FSD _v1.2.pdf sec. 1.2 (p.6-7, wins); ACM_Functional_Document_v1.0.pdf sec. 7 (p.8-9); HCL_CAC.pptx (high-level only, not module-specific)
code_summary: Web (React): spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleAddEdit.js, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/Module/*. API (iz): spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java -> ApplicationModuleRepository -> table ACM_APPLICATION_MODULE. Not in external API (spms_common_ez_api_app-main has no module endpoint found).
note: Compared with ACM_FSD _v1.2.pdf sec. 1.2 (wins when decks disagree). Findings were checked against code; database behavior (FKs, roleId values) cannot be verified from the repo. HCL_CAC.pptx is image-only and high-level, so it is not used as step evidence.
recommendation: Partial claim: list, search, add, delete, confirmation and no-approval work. Fix before claiming in full: per-column sort, AC-ADMIN check on the API, description-only edit on the API, specific error messages.

steps.step: Only Staff with the AC-ADMIN role can access Manage Modules
steps.detail: The restriction exists only in the UI: the Manage Modules menu item shows when the user's role in the ACM application equals 'AC-admin' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Utility/constant.js:13, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/LayoutACM.js:51). The /acm/manage-module route (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Navigation/RoutesConfig.js:129) only checks that the user has any ACM application (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Navigation/PrivateRouteConfig.js:16, :27), not AC-ADMIN. On the API side, spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java:21-60 has no role check and spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/security/WebSecurityConfig.java:167 opens '/**' with permitAll(), so the module endpoints can be called without the AC-ADMIN role. 'AC-admin' in the UI vs 'AC-ADMIN' in the FSD: the roleId value in the database cannot be verified from the repo. AAD login and the landing page are not part of this story's trace.

steps.step: Staff selects Manage Modules; the system lists Application ID, Module ID and Module Name of all modules
steps.detail: When Manage Modules is selected, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/index.js:65 dispatches getModule, the saga spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/Module/ModuleGetSaga.js:17 POSTs to viewAllModules, and spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java:41-48 calls spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:94-100 (findAll). The table spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js:29-35 uses the headers 'Application ID', 'Module ID', 'Module Name', 'Action' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Utility/constant.js:75). Delete is a hard delete (no status column in spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/ApplicationModule.java:19-55), so 'all status except deleted' equals all rows.

steps.step: Staff can search by Module ID and Module Name
steps.detail: The search box spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js:26 dispatches getModule with searchText (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js:14-16). spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java:44-45 forwards it to spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:124-130, which uses the query findByModuleIdContainingOrModuleNameContaining (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/repository/ApplicationModuleRepository.java:27). Note: spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java:44 reads request.getSearchText() although the body is required=false, so an empty body would throw NullPointerException; the UI always sends a body.

steps.step: Staff can sort the Module ID and Module Name columns
steps.detail: There is no sort control on the table. The list is always sorted by moduleName through sortObject (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/index.js:286, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Packages/Common.js:50-55); spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:310-350 (Module table) has no sort handler and the table headers are plain text. User-driven sort on Module ID or Module Name does not exist.

steps.step: Staff can export the searched/filtered data to Excel
steps.detail: The export button spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js:40 uses ExportToExcel (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ExportToExcel.js:2, :8) with the currently loaded data (moduleData, i.e. the latest search result) and the columns APPLICATION_ID, MODULE_ID, MODULE_NAME, DESCRIPTION (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js:17-22). The output is a CSV file 'Modules.csv' via react-csv, not an Excel (.xlsx) file.

steps.step: Add New Module opens a form: application, module name, module ID, description (optional)
steps.detail: The 'Add New Module' button (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleTableView.js:11-13, :37) opens the form spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleAddEdit.js:24-27 with an application dropdown, Module Name, Module ID (maxlength 100) and an optional Description (maxlength 200), matching the limits in ACM_Functional_Document_v1.0.pdf p.9. Form validation is in spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/SechmaValidation.js:19-24 (application required, ID and name required, description max 200).

steps.step: Submit sends the request to the backend, which creates the module in the database
steps.detail: Submit dispatches postModule with the create payload (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/index.js:170-184), the saga spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/Module/ModuleSaga.js:17-27 POSTs to createModule, and spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java:29-33 calls spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:59-69: findByModuleId check, and if not found it loads the application and calls appModuleRepository.save into table ACM_APPLICATION_MODULE (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/ApplicationModule.java:17-18). Note: the duplicate check uses moduleId only across all applications (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:60), while the unique constraint is only visible in the JPA entity (ApplicationModule.java:17-18, per APPLICATION_ID and MODULE_ID); the real DB constraint cannot be verified from the repo. The API only has @NotBlank for name/ID (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/dto/ModuleCreateRequest.java:14-19), so the FD's 100-character limit is only in the UI; the API description max is 256 (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/dto/ModuleCreateRequest.java:20) vs 200 in the UI.

steps.step: When editing, Staff may only change the description
steps.detail: The UI is correct: in edit mode the application dropdown, Module Name and Module ID are disabled (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageModule/ModuleAddEdit.js:24-26) and only Description can be changed. However the edit payload still sends moduleName (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/index.js:175-182) and the API saves it: spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:74 setModuleName and :75 setDescription, DTO spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/dto/ModuleUpdateRequest.java:16-18. So the 'description only' rule is enforced in the UI only; a direct API request can change the Module Name. ACM_Functional_Document_v1.0.pdf p.9 also says Module Name cannot be changed after creation.

steps.step: Delete shows a confirmation modal, then the module is deleted
steps.detail: The delete icon on a Module row (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:310 onward) calls handleRemove (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:173-183), which opens the confirmation modal (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js:24, :98-117). The confirm button calls handleDelete (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:185-189) -> deleteModule, saga spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/Module/DeleteModuleSaga.js:18-27 -> POST deleteModule, spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/ApplicationModuleController.java:56-60 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:110-118 (existence check, then removeByModuleId). After success the list is reloaded (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/Module/DeleteModuleSaga.js:28).

steps.step: Deleting a module automatically deletes all associated roles and functions
steps.detail: What gets deleted is the module's Function rows (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/ApplicationModule.java:53 cascade ALL + orphanRemoval) and those functions' RoleFunction rows (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/Function.java:42). A Role is linked to an application, not to a module (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/Role.java:35), so Role rows are not deleted; only the role-function mappings go. The cascade relies on the derived delete removeByModuleId (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/repository/ApplicationModuleRepository.java:23) loading the entity first; this behavior is not tested in the repo and needs verification.

steps.step: If retrieving or submitting data fails, Staff sees a modal with an appropriate error message
steps.detail: A global error modal exists: 404/500 and 400 responses set a flag (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Services/axios.configuration.js:43-47) and spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ContentLayout.js:11-15 shows a generic message 'We are unable to display the requested page...' / 'unable to retrieve the record...'. The message is not specific (e.g. a duplicate module ID from spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:62 becomes the generic message). Also NotExistsException is returned as HTTP 200 (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/exception/CustomControllerAdvice.java:27-30), so updating or deleting a module that no longer exists does not raise the error modal in the UI.

steps.step: There is no approval process for creating, updating or deleting a module
steps.detail: Create, update and delete write or remove directly in the database (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/ApplicationModuleService.java:65, :79, :113). The entity spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/ApplicationModule.java:19-55 has no status column or approval relation, and there is no supporter/approver step on the module path.
